title: Introducing OpenAI for Ireland
summary: OpenAI launches OpenAI for Ireland, partnering with the Irish Government, Dogpatch Labs and Patch to help SMEs, founders and young builders use AI to innovate, boost productivity and build the next generation of Irish tech startups.
body: OpenAI launches OpenAI for Ireland, partnering with the Irish Government, Dogpatch Labs and Patch to help SMEs, founders and young builders use AI to innovate, boost productivity and build the next generation of Irish tech startups.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布在爱尔兰启动合作项目，旨在支持当地中小企业和初创公司利用AI技术进行创新。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于企业市场拓展与合作公告，不涉及模型技术层面的更新。
